title: Universaarl Number Series Lines official New route write gate
goal: Test the Microsoft Learn-backed Number Series Lines path for U-CUST only: Zeilen -> Neu -> Startdatum -> Startnr. -> Endnr.; then reopen proof. Do not assign setup or create master data.

sourceBackedBy.title: Microsoft Learn: Create number series
sourceBackedBy.claimSupported: No. Series use Lines with Starting Date, Starting No. and Ending No.; Manual Nos. and Allow Gaps are separate settings; setup assignment happens later in setup pages.

successCriteria: U-CUST Lines page is opened in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Startdatum, Startnr. and Endnr. are entered by the official Lines New route or target values are already visible.
After reopening U-CUST Lines, U-CUST00001 and U-CUST99999 are visible in the correct line.
No setup assignment, master data, preview posting or posting occurs.
No gap/open checkbox is changed without explicit gate.
nextSafeAction: Run the official U-CUST Number Series Lines New route with before/after/reopen evidence.
result: TARGET-016I did not prove U-CUST Startnr./Endnr. persistence after reopen.

Startnr./Starting No. cell was not targetable.
Endnr./Ending No. cell was not targetable.
